_comment: Onboarding matrix v1.0 — 25 steps covering M365, Azure AD, Intune, Comms, HR and Compliance.
_usage: Steps are filtered by role and department at runtime. 'required_for' is a list of dept/role patterns; '*' means all.

steps.title: Create M365 user account
steps.description: Provision the Azure AD / Entra ID user account with correct UPN, display name, department, job title and usage location.

steps.title: Assign appropriate licence (E3 / E5 / F3)
steps.description: Apply the correct M365 licence SKU based on role requirements. Disable unused service plans to reduce exposure.

steps.title: Add to department security groups
steps.description: Add user to all Azure AD security groups for their department, granting access to shared resources and SharePoint sites.

steps.title: Add to distribution lists
steps.description: Subscribe user to relevant department and all-staff distribution lists in Exchange Online.

steps.title: Enable MFA and set authentication methods
steps.description: Enforce MFA registration via Conditional Access. Pre-configure TOTP / Authenticator app and set SSPR auth methods.

steps.title: Conditional Access policy verification
steps.description: Confirm user is covered by the correct Conditional Access policies (compliant device, MFA required, named locations).

steps.title: Shared mailbox access grants
steps.description: Grant SendAs / FullAccess permissions to any shared mailboxes the role requires.

steps.title: SharePoint site access
steps.description: Grant access to department SharePoint sites and document libraries. Configure sensitivity labels if required.

steps.title: Teams channel memberships
steps.description: Add user to relevant Microsoft Teams teams and channels including the general staff team and department channel.

steps.title: Intune device enrolment preparation
steps.description: Create the device enrolment profile and assign it to the user. Send enrolment instructions to the user's personal email.

steps.title: Device naming convention applied
steps.description: Pre-name the device according to asset naming convention (e.g. DEPT-ROLE-XXXX) in Autopilot / Intune.

steps.title: Software package deployment
steps.description: Assign mandatory software packages via Intune: Office 365 Apps, endpoint security agent, VPN client, and role-specific tooling.

steps.title: VPN / remote access configuration
steps.description: Create VPN certificate and user profile. Test connectivity from an external network before day 1.

steps.title: Line-of-business application access
steps.description: Grant access to role-specific LOB applications (ERP, CRM, ITSM, developer tools, etc.) with appropriate permission levels.

steps.title: Onboarding ticket raised in ITSM
steps.description: Log the onboarding request in the service desk (e.g. ServiceNow / Jira) and link all provisioning sub-tasks to the parent ticket.

steps.title: HR system record linked
steps.description: Verify the HR system record matches the Azure AD account (employee ID, cost centre, manager hierarchy).

steps.title: Welcome email sent
steps.description: Send the personalised welcome email to the new starter's personal email and manager with login credentials and first-day instructions.

steps.title: Day-1 guide delivered
steps.description: Provide the day-1 guide covering building access, IT setup, system logins, team contacts and the first-week agenda.

steps.title: Manager introduction call scheduled
steps.description: Schedule the first 1-to-1 between the new starter and their line manager within the first three working days.

steps.title: IT induction session booked
steps.description: Book the new starter into the IT induction session covering: password policies, data handling, acceptable use, remote working.

steps.title: Acceptable Use Policy sent and acknowledged
steps.description: Issue the AUP to the new starter. Record their digital acknowledgement in the compliance system.

steps.title: Security awareness training assigned
steps.description: Enrol the user in mandatory security awareness training (phishing simulation platform, annual e-learning modules).

steps.title: Emergency contact recorded
steps.description: Capture emergency contact details in the HR system. Confirm next-of-kin is recorded.

steps.title: Asset register updated
steps.description: Log the assigned laptop / peripherals / mobile device in the IT asset register with serial numbers and assignment date.

steps.title: Day-30 check-in reminder set
steps.description: Schedule a 30-day check-in for manager and IT to confirm all access is working, identify gaps, and close any outstanding tasks.
